title: Reply to ``Comment on `The nature of slow dynamics in a minimal model of frustration-limited domains'" by J. Schmalian, P.G. Wolynes and S. Wu
abstract: We present simulation results suggesting that the stripe glass state described by Schmalian et al. for the Brazovskii model, cond-mat/0305420, may be dynamically unstable below the fluctuation-induced first-order transition temperature.
